scope_note: County incremental sources only. Statewide NJGIN/MOD-IV, NJ DCA construction, FEMA flood, NJDEP environmental, ACS/Census geography, and six-hub NJ state intelligence are referenced, not reacquired. No shared four-county manifest is edited here.

sources.source_name: Monmouth County GeoHub / self-service open data
identifier_fields: item id when catalog is available
sources.refresh_method: GeoHub shapefile/GeoJSON download when catalog is healthy; do not commit large GIS files.
sources.terms_notes: County public GIS brochure invites shapefile download for education/GIS use. Additional layers may require OPRA.
sources.redistribution_notes: Do not treat parcel polygons as legal survey. Confirm county terms of use before republication of downloaded shapefiles.
sources.blocker: Hub search API HTTP 400 and data.json HTTP 500 during this ticket. Portal HTML is live.
sources.recommended_next_action: Retry GeoHub catalog when healthy; acquire layer item IDs only. Do not OPRA-wait.

sources.source_name: NJGIN Parcels and MOD-IV Composite (Monmouth filter)

sources.recommended_next_action: Reuse statewide NJGIN. Count verified: 249796 Monmouth features.

sources.source_name: Monmouth County Open Public Records Search (OPRS)
sources.refresh_method: Interactive Clerk and Tax Board search. Tax Board Computerized Data (MOD-IV and Sales Data from 1995) advertises exportable search results. That is not a documented bulk API.
sources.terms_notes: Terms of Use: as-is/as-available; no warranty of accuracy, currentness, or fitness. Traffic is monitored. Disclaimer: not for title searches.
sources.redistribution_notes: Public land record is not a recommendation. Mortgage recording is not a current balance. Do not bulk scrape. Do not restore Daniel's Law-redacted owner names into network products.
sources.blocker: Session-based public search. No documented bulk API for Clerk images.
sources.recommended_next_action: See docs/nj-counties/monmouth-oprs-access-assessment.md and the narrow metadata request. Do not scrape.

sources.refresh_method: Re-open current listing page. Capture status inventory only.
sources.terms_notes: Public service summary. Sheriff does not warrant accuracy, completeness, or timeliness. Confirm status at the office before a sale.
sources.redistribution_notes: Scheduled != completed. Adjourned != completed. Bankruptcy != completed. Not a marketing list. Defendant names not stored.
sources.recommended_next_action: Keep status inventory. Do not productize addresses as a buyer list.

sources.source_name: Monmouth County Division of Consumer Affairs
sources.refresh_method: Phone 732-431-7900 or email consumeraffairs@co.monmouth.nj.us for a business complaint history. No bulk download.
sources.terms_notes: Office investigates/mediates complaints and can provide complaint history on a business before a consumer does business with the company. Complaint is not a violation.
sources.redistribution_notes: Exclude complainant PII and narratives. Do not wait on OPRA for this ticket.
sources.blocker: No public bulk file. Lookup is staff-mediated.
sources.recommended_next_action: Send the narrow non-PII request in docs/nj-counties/monmouth-consumer-affairs-request.md. Do not wait.
